title: Weighted fit with unequal standard errors
description: Four points whose last two observations are twice as uncertain as the first two. The weighting has to actually happen: an unweighted solver gets a visibly different answer.
assumptions: The response is linear in x, with an intercept.
The standard error given for each observation is the true standard deviation of its noise, so the last two observations carry a quarter of the weight of the first two.
limitations: This is synthetic data with four points and two parameters. Two residual degrees of freedom are not enough to say much about whether the linear model is right.
The intervals assume the declared standard errors are correct. They test the fit, not that assumption.
